overview: After a deadly encounter with a purse snatcher, a comic-book-obsessed man  sets out to become a masked superhero, putting himself on course to discover his inner villain in this darkly comic crime film.

title: Beauty Goes Up the Mountain
overview: Thirty years after a young Bunun tribeswoman named Beauty vanished from her hometown, she returns—worn by two failed marriages—only to die at the foot of Yushan. Her two childhood sweethearts’ risk everything: they swap her body with a pig carcass, and under cover of night, secretly carry her up the sacred peak, to bury her in the mountain where she always longed to — finally confronting the long silence of their people’s suffering.

title: BIRDMAN 3
overview: The Birdman Trilogy ends with Birdman 3.  18.12.26 is Birdsday

title: Hearts All Aglow
overview: Mari is a fiercely intelligent music historian who manages to get an invite to the annual Christmas gala for the local music museum and has one goal: secure an interview with Tasha the legendary Grammy award-winning singer, record producer, and museum’s founder. Mari has to summon the courage to ask the mogul who rarely does interviews these days for this favor, which proves more difficult than anticipated. Also crashing the gala is Julian, a polished and perpetually busy New York attorney on a mission of his own: his late mother received the autograph of Nat King Cole on a piece of sheet music when she was a young girl and he regrettably donated this treasured piece of family history to the DuPree Museum while emotionally numb in the aftermath of his mother’s death. Now his sister tells him she wants to give the framed sheet music to her daughter/his niece, who inherited her grandmother’s musical talent, for Christmas, and Julian is determined to bring it back home.

title: Lagarto de Celofán
overview: When the owner of their rehearsal space confiscates their instruments, the band "Cellophane Lizard" teams up with the owner of the "New York Dogs" bar to recover their instruments and fulfill their promise to the singer's deceased father: to give their first concert.

title: Christmas Wrapped in Love
overview: Natasha Lloyd has built a unique business helping clients locate thoughtful, one-of-a-kind gifts for the people they love. When overworked surgeon Ryan Bartlett finds himself tasked with purchasing meaningful Christmas gifts for his entire family, he hires Natasha for help. To uncover the perfect presents, Natasha agrees to pose as Ryan’s girlfriend and spend the holiday season getting to know his family. What begins as a professional arrangement soon becomes something much more as Natasha discovers the true meaning of family, belonging, and love at Christmas.

title: Barking All the Way
overview: Billie is a workaholic realtor who heads home for Christmas but her journey is derailed after a loveable but chaotic canine named Yappy almost causes her car to crash. After talking to Yappy's owner, the mysterious yet oddly familiar Mrs. C, Billie agrees to watch Yappy while she visits her grandchildren for the holidays. Yappy ends up playing the role of matchmaker and new best friend, pulling Billie towards her traveling contractor ex-boyfriend from high school, Hutch. Eager to move on, she's determined to leave Hutch in the past, but when her mother hires him to work on their shed, she finds herself spending more time with him than she ever expected. As the holidays draw closer, Billie begins to question whether chasing her dream of becoming her firm's number one seller is truly what she wants. When the mysterious Mrs. C leaves her cabin for Billie and Hutch to breathe new life into, her answer may come sooner than expected.

title: The Porch Pisser and the Princess
overview: The Porch Pisser and The Princess is a dark comedy about Edward, a lost teen who feels like his life has no purpose. After a strange act of rebellion against his teachers gains attention, May O’Connell, an uptight student journalist, becomes interested in his story. As the school starts panicking and the investigation grows, Edward and May get pulled into something bigger than either of them expected.

title: One Dying Star
overview: A fascinating story of science-fiction films that tried to predict the future of a socialist country that didn’t live long enough to see it.

title: Amateur Hour
overview: When Bharles Billiam and Sam Jones set out to make their very own movie, they learn that it might not be as easy as it seems. Together, the two entirely unqualified "filmmakers" struggle to find a cast, a budget, and any competency at all, putting them through a series of absurd misadventures along the way.

title: Lessons in Stagnance
overview: Over the course of one stagnant day in a small town, two directionless, codependent dorks stumble through friendship, insecurity, and love while doing everything they can to avoid growing up.

title: Save the Date for Christmas
overview: Susie has checked out on dating while Alec is a hopeless romantic, and these longtime friends have both struck out in the love department after failing to meet the right man. After being each other's plus-one to what feels like the twentieth wedding this year, they vow to take a break from attending weddings and looking for their respective prince charming. That break doesn't last long. The next day, Susie's sister announces a last-minute Christmas wedding... and Susie convinces Alec to tag along. The objective for the week? Survive as the two lone single people and avoid family matchmaking. Over time, the Christmas wedding duties and time with family during the holidays force these two best friends to forge a new appreciation for love and marriage. Susie finds herself turning over a new leaf in pursuing romance while Alec discovers love can walk into your life when you least expect it.

title: Classified
overview: "I can’t put words to you, I can’t put labels to you; but what I can put are a whole ton of emotions and feelings to you, and even then I can’t put words to those."

title: AMER D'I
overview: Isaiah is a young man who decides to leave his family and friends to live and wander the streets of Paris after a painful past event.  Amidst encounters, ghosts, drugs, and self-destruction, Iz will plunge headlong into the capital.

title: Lau Kumude Hidyo Hero Banna
overview: Lau Kumud Hidyo Hero Banna is an inspiring music video about dreams, friendship, and the journey of becoming a hero. Kumude leaves his home in Dang with big dreams in his heart and travels to Kathmandu to become a hero. On the way, he meets his two close friends who support him and help change his style with black sunglasses, black jeans, a tough jacket, and stylish black Dingo shoes. Looking smart and confident, Kumude walks proudly like a real hero. During the journey, he meets a kind tempo rider girl who supports and encourages him. Their adventure becomes difficult when the tempo tyre gets punctured on the road. Later, a helpful truck driver gives Kumude a ride towards Kathmandu. As they travel through hills, rivers, forests, and beautiful landscapes, Kumude enjoys the beauty of Nepal and learns that becoming a hero needs courage, confidence, friendship, and belief in dreams.

title: The Director's Corpse
overview: A young journalist investigates a film student's claim that the corpse of a 125-year-old director continues to direct the crew on set, and gradually uncovers evidence that casts doubt not only on the student's sanity but also on the veracity of the story itself.

title: ARASHI LIVE TOUR 2026「We are ARASHI -Prime Video Edition-」
overview: Curated and specially edited by group member Jun Matsumoto, this Farewell Special features exclusive footage from their final 5-city, 15-show stadium tour from their Live Tour 2026 「We are ARASHI 」.

title: Captain Bonanza!
overview: Daring hero Captain Bonanza -- né Hudson Hill -- uncovers a sinister plot surrounding three magic idols in the mystic Hudson Valley. But this scheme is far greater, and far deadlier, than he ever could have imagined.

title: Sutukai Aijanu Maya
overview: Sutukai Aijanu Maya is a movie song Kumude Hidyo Hero Banna

title: Jumanji: Open World
overview: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us - as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.

title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
overview: Red faces his greatest challenge yet - surviving fatherhood - while saving the world.

title: Roma elastica
overview: 1982. French actress Eddie is on the verge of collapse and travels to Rome accompanied by her loyal makeup artist, Valentina, to shoot a science-fiction film – a film that could be her last one.

title: Kumaari
overview: An upcoming thriller.

title: Bad Dog
overview: Adaptation of Ihor Antoniuk's work "Bad Dog"

title: Limbo
overview: Short film based on Kyrylo Polovinko's novel "Limbo. Place of Lost Souls"

title: The Trial
overview: Adaptation of Franz Kafka's novel "The Trial"

title: King
overview: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

title: Oceanic
overview: Adyr, a brilliant scientist working at a public university in Rio de Janeiro, conducts cutting-edge research into psychedelics as a treatment for alcoholism—the disease that claimed her husband’s life. When she becomes the target of a group seeking to appropriate her work, Adyr must fight to complete her research while protecting her own life and that of her son, Tom.

title: Anna From Mexico
overview: Anna From Mexico Is Upcoming Kannada Movie Directed by Shankar Guru.

title: 5 cm: Revolusi Hati
overview: Four inseparable companions pledge lifelong solidarity upon entering secondary education, only for their collective bond to undergo severe emotional and structural strain when the introduction of romantic interests and an transformative journey outside the metropolis force them to confront the inevitable realities of maturity.

title: Los Vaqueros
overview: In the early 1990s in West Texas, three ambitious young men begin their ascent to notoriety within their small town crime organization as they navigate the treacherous underworld of drugs, gambling, and illicit deals. Their rise to power brings both wealth and danger, testing their bonds and morality in a world where trust is fragile and betrayal is commonplace.

title: Sutukai Aijanu Maya Gaijamla Relaima Chadera
overview: Sutukai Aijanu Maya Gaijamla Relaima Chadera is a romantic musical story about a dream boy who always wishes to become a film hero. One day, while walking with his sister near Gokarna Shaheed Smarak Park in Kathmandu, he sees a film song being shot. Excited by the cameras, lights, music, and dancers, he asks his sister to go closer. Among the dancers, he notices a beautiful girl whose graceful dance immediately captures his heart. He begins to imagine himself as the hero of the song, dancing and romancing with her. In his dream, they share joyful and romantic moments filled with love, laughter, and chemistry. He expresses his feelings and even proposes marriage, dreaming of spending their lives together. At the end of the song, the girl whispers in his ear, “Let’s go together.” Suddenly, the director says, “Okay, cut!” and the dream boy returns to reality. His sister takes him home, leaving him with a beautiful dream of love and his wish to become a film hero.

title: BASTA: Start of the Game
overview: Rostov in the early 2000s was the cradle of Russian hip-hop: clubs, apartment concerts, street brawls. Basta searched for his voice, facing trials, mistrust, and hostile competitors, but it was his honest lyrics and charisma that first captivated the Rostov hip-hop community. Against the backdrop of first love, friendship, and family trials, he made his ultimate choice: to devote himself to music.

title: Filosofi Teras
overview: A dedicated young woman serving as her family's primary financial provider finds her matrimonial aspirations permanently derailed when she uncovers a debilitating secret: their ancestral home was pawned by her late father to finance her eldest brother's opulent wedding.

title: Swell
overview: The seasoned Captain Mitsos Avgoustis stubbornly refuses to retire. The ocean swell has lodged itself in his mind, and the sea simply will not give him back.  For twelve years he has been away from Greece—estranged from his family, at odds with the shipping company, yet bound by unshakable ties to the 22 sailors aboard the cargo ship ATHOS III. Defiant and unwilling to obey, he somehow keeps finding cargo, calling at ports, loading and unloading, silently roaming the waters of the Pacific.  Day and night, he battles the relentless gales on the lonely voyages of his mind and heart, where the secret he carries has long since dropped anchor.

title: Kochschule Schwarz
overview: Munich, 1938: After his traditional Jewish restaurant was destroyed by the Nazis during Kristallnacht, restaurateur Richard Schwarz and charismatic jack-of-all-trades Edgar Enders hatch a daring plan. They open a sophisticated Jewish cooking school.

title: Who Killed Artur Falcão?
overview: On a Christmas Eve that quickly spirals out of control, a group of friends finds themselves embroiled in an unlikely mystery that no one quite knows how to solve. Amid absurd suspicions, embarrassing revelations, and an investigation as improvised as it is chaotic, Christmas Eve dinner transforms into a game of accusations where everyone seems to have something to hide.

title: Autokraten
overview: In a luxurious penthouse, Diana and Stefan welcome strangers into a treacherous game of seduction, manipulation, and power. When Pan enters their world, he becomes the subject of an experiment in which charm becomes a weapon and closeness becomes a means of control. But with Olga’s arrival, a player emerges who understands the rules faster than her hosts. The balance of power shifts and control turns into a struggle for survival.

title: Tony's Loop
overview: After blacking out, a young man wakes on the floor of an unfamiliar place with no memory of how he got there. When he discovers he is trapped in a time loop, his desperate search for freedom comes at an increasingly dangerous price.

title: Werwulf
overview: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

title: Mr. Irrelevant
overview: The last player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants, underdog John Tuggle, defies expectations on and off the field for head coach Bill Parcells, his newfound love, and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

title: Artificial
overview: The story of OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, centred on his controversial firing and re-hiring in November 2023, a movement led by co-founder Ilya Sutskever.

title: Everything Else Is Noise
overview: Rosa, a contemporary music composer, agrees to give her first television interview at her colleague Tere’s apartment to keep it secret from her husband. What begins as a simple professional conversation turns into an absurd and comic portrait of rivalries and affections among three women—Rosa, Tere, and Tere’s daughter Luisa—interrupted by power outages, a constantly barking dog, and the visit of a famous composer. As the interview unravels, family and artistic tensions surface, revealing, with humor, both the fragility of prestige and the strength of complicity.

title: Sukiyaki
overview: In 1963, as Japan emerged from the shadows of war into an era of extraordinary transformation, an unlikely song made music history. "Ue o Muite Arukou," known internationally as "Sukiyaki," became the first Japanese song to top the U.S. Billboard charts, remaining at No. 1 for three weeks and captivating listeners around the world.

title: Beck 55 – The Wages of Sin
overview: The film marks a major departure for the series, as the beloved character Martin Beck finally retires.

title: Our House
overview: Charls Carroll stars as a Revolutionary War soldier washed ashore from the past and resurrected.

title: Amir
overview: A gifted 10-year-old boy who can see mythical creatures must warn a skeptical village of the impending catastrophe.

title: Bye Bye Love: Detective Is in the Bar
overview: Two cases lead a detective and Takada into a dark conspiracy. What truth lies beyond the white snow?

title: wyrdo
overview: A Christmas dinner party is interrupted by an uninvited guest.

title: The Pools
overview: A teenager trapped inside a seemingly endless aquatic labyrinth of swimming pools, towering waterslides, flooded corridors, and impossible architecture. As he ventures deeper into the surreal liminal maze and reality itself begins to unravel, a mysterious creature stalks him from beneath the water, forcing him to find a way out before he disappears forever.

title: Los Salvajes Bravos
overview: In 1887, an Igorot veteran is forced to parade his own people as "savages" at a Madrid exposition. Caught between his loyalty to Spain and the survival of his people, he must use his knowledge of the empire to lead them on a daring escape home.

title: Red Flag Bhalobasha Beshi
overview: Dibyojyoti Dutta stars opposite Divyani Mondal.

title: Haunted Carnival
overview: As the carnival turns into a death trap, the guests must survive challenges while carnival freaks hunt every single one of them.

title: The Greatest Showdown
overview: After an explosive first encounter, two business owners become rivals. Their all-out war may cost them everything they've worked for.

title: Someone Dies Tonight
overview: A group of friends sets out on a holiday road trip to Greece. On their way south, they are intercepted by a group of Croatian gangsters. Locked in a remote house, they find themselves struggling for their lives.

title: Hösten med Göran
overview: The film follows the narcissist and divorced father Göran as he tries to balance his life between having children, an expensive ADHD diagnosis and the search for love. At the same time, his best friend Alex struggles with a failing marriage. Together, they try to find joy in life, hope and maybe even love.

title: 2nd Miracle in Cell No.7
overview: Before the events of Miracle in Cell No. 7, a devoted father fights to protect his family after a tragedy leads to a custody battle.

title: A Perfect Marriage
overview: An official entry to the 52nd Metro Manila Film Festival.

title: Little Hope
overview: Follows a young girl with cancer whose mother is already gone. Knowing her time is short, she spends it looking for someone to stay with her father after she dies.

title: Kyllä isä osaa Espanjassa
overview: Intergenerational relationships and conflicts take on a new dimension as a Finnish family encounters everyday life in Spain.

title: Chiranjeevi Hanuman: The Eternal
overview: An AI-generated film about the Hindu god Hanuman; it will draw from the sacred texts of Indian epic 'Ramayana' and Puranic literature to create what producers describe as an “awe-inspiring, visual odyssey designed to be enjoyed as a shared experience in theaters.”

title: Aganko Tulshi Mathama
overview: Aganko Tulshi Mathama is a music video story about mother and son

title: Bike Ambulance Dada
overview: Based on the life of Padma Shri Karimul Haque. The world's first bike ambulance man who has saved over 7,000 lives.

title: Queen Victoria Aar Goyenda Kanaichawron
overview: A detective thriller based on Rajarshi Das Bhowmik's story Kalapaanir Disha.

title: Sith Wars Ep IV - Rise of the Sith Empire
overview: Jakkai is under the protection and guidance of Master Yoda. Darth Vader is eager to find and kill them, while the Resistance has received information that the Empire possesses a new weapon capable of destroying a planet.

title: 'Tis the Season
overview: Two wealthy children hold a washed-up mall Santa hostage as their Christmas Eve spirals into chaos.

title: The Farm
overview: Filmmaker Evan W. Gerdes shoots his family's land in Groesbeck, Texas from sunrise to sunset, using long, uninterrupted takes with natural ambience to translate his fondness for the place he grew up.

title: Rematched
overview: Two strangers sitting outside of a cafe are pulled into a young supernatural girl's illusion of reality, in an attempt for them to meet while being confronted by their deepest truths.

title: ViQueens
overview: Fearless Viking girls Ingrid and Hedvig defy tradition to return a stowaway boy to China. Their journey spans icy fjords, Byzantine intrigue, and the fabled Silk Road, blending Viking grit with ancient Chinese wisdom, unexpected alliances, and a touch of magic.

title: Maybe We Were Fire
overview: Danny and Eve -- two high school sweethearts who tied the knot just shy at 18, suddenly find themselves at a crossroads when they suddenly separate 10 years later. Now, the once inspeparable couple must navigate a life without each other while their friends, family, and acquaintances are all caught in the middle. Flashbacks detailing their relationship follow.

title: Sunnyside
overview: Spanning decades, cultures, and quiet family secrets, Sunnyside is an intimate documentary portrait of Nicholas, a second-generation Greek-American reflecting on a lifetime of memory, identity, and profound transformation. From a cramped childhood bedroom in Sunnyside, Queens, to summers at a Long Island bungalow, the film explores the contrast between a rigid city upbringing and the fleeting freedom of youth. As Nicholas tells stories of his own path—architectural journeys in Paris, coming to terms with his identity in 1970s New York, and finding true partnership—he uncovers unspoken truths about his family's immigrant sacrifices and long-buried grief. Now the sole survivor of his family of seven, Nicholas preserves their fragile legacy, offering a deeply poignant meditation on what it means to hold the key to a forgotten past.

title: unbearableness
overview: When emotional blindness and loneliness collide, bizarre chain of events unravels.

title: 3rd FLOOR
overview: A routine elevator ride becomes a battlefield when Maya Uche, a Black activist, and Brett Kiminski, a white conservative, are trapped together between floors. With nowhere to run, their assumptions, anger, and buried grief rise to the surface, forcing both strangers to face the truth behind their politics — and the pain that made them who they are.

title: The Audition
overview: A struggling actor, Nikhil Dagga , 31 stands at the brink of surrender. Broke and beaten down, he retreats to a claustrophobic Mumbai apartment where intrusive neighbors and mounting debts test his resolve. When his final chance at redemption collapses, one desperate, late-night performance becomes an unexpected act of rebellion.

title: KITTY, KITTY!
overview: An upcoming indie horror film based on Dr. Seuss ' The Cat in the Hat.

title: Alexandria, Mon Amour
overview: After locking eyes with a striking stranger in an art museum, a disillusioned romantic spots her everywhere he goes across the city, driving him to finally break the silence before she vanishes into the crowd forever.

title: Until the Day Ends
overview: Two teenagers protesting political repression must flee, taking with them only their love and a dog.

title: Apophis 2029
overview: On April 13, 2029, the asteroid Apophis will pass close enough to Earth, it will be below our satellites. It will dip below and pop back out.

title: The Daughters of Abraham
overview: After several years apart, Myriam, a young woman from a Muslim background who grew up in Marseille, reconnects with Eva, who comes from a Jewish family, during the summer vacation. Together, they live out their youth outside the imposed norms. But this carefree summer begins to unravel when a tragedy upends the balance of their social and family circles—and soon, their own destinies.

title: Tie Man
overview: Marjolaine, model police officer, hasn't been the same since her parents were murdered and her sister kidnapped. She joins forces with TIE MAN, a disfigured vigilante to seek revenge against the man responsible, the power mad Franz DeMann.

A family takes the time to plan a surprise birthday party for their daughter, Mélodie. But the party they organized is nothing compared to the unpleasant surprise that awaits them once the preparations are complete.

title: The "Set-Up" Boxer
overview: Tired of being the punching bag of Alexandria's worst boxers, A young boxer decides to confront a money collector that works in the corrupted betting business in the underground boxing championships.

title: Logan
overview: In development.

overview: A man recalls his childhood in 1950s West Germany as a nine-year-old boy discovering his father’s clandestine work with a dominant family guest—a time when his fear of the Sandman of folklore may have resurfaced in his own act of cruelty.

title: Fallout
overview: Spencer arrives in England to reunite with his estranged sister Joan on the evening of her fiancé's funeral. At dinner, tensions rise between the siblings and their close friends.

title: Dawn of Soengsang
overview: In the era when the communists ruled the city, the red zone of the struggle for power, hid the evil legend of the forest, roaring and fanging, occupying the haunted land for hundreds of years.

title: Wraith
overview: A psychological horror in which a man named Mark wanders a dark, deserted hospital looking for his supposedly dead wife, whose spirit continues to call out to him beyond the halls…

title: Querent
overview: Following Romy’s recent heartbreak, mysterious red stains begin to appear and she consults her spiritual brother in hopes of finding answers.

title: Pendulum
overview: A couple, journeys to a retreat in New Mexico seeking healing. Patrick grows skeptical of the retreat's leader as Abigail falls under her influence. They wonder if the group's practices offer genuine healing or conceal a terrifying truth.

title: Now Playing
overview: After mocking the movie theatre experience, Logan finds himself trapped in a cinematic nightmare. Haunted by vengeful spirits, he must escape the theatre before credits – and heads – roll.

title: Bone Singer
overview: Kaia, a struggling artist, has been making things happen that she can't explain. Sadie, a young witch, must carry out a cruel ritual, or risk her coven's death. As Kaia and Sadie's fates become increasingly intertwined, the two will go down a path that will irreversibly alter both of their lives.

title: Quarantine
overview: The film follows a May 1st protest in Paris, from the intensity of collective struggle to the quiet return to the suburbs. Between a day of political resistance and a simple public holiday, it explores what remains of collective action once the crowd disperses.

At 8:38 PM, May wakes up in a room with no memory. With one lifeline call, she must uncover the truth, before it’s too late. But is the voice helping her… or hiding something darker? 8 minutes is all she has.

title: Eurotrash
overview: A writer sets off on a road trip through Switzerland with his drunk and terminally ill mother, after realizing his wealthy family members are the very worst kind of people.

title: Not All Men
overview: After breaking free from a long, toxic relationship, Fernanda embarks on a weekend getaway with three friends, seeking solace and distraction. However, what begins as an escape quickly devolves into a whirlwind of tension and hidden agendas, as the group's true intentions come to light, forcing Fernanda to confront the reality she sought to escape.

title: Teacher Boy
overview: A Canadian teacher in China, juggling two relationships, becomes entangled with a pair of small-time crooks as the consequences of his choices begin to close in on him.

title: Deathsman
overview: Percy Thompson (a Relocator for the Time Investigation Corporation) finds more than he bargained for when searching for his target.

title: Any Other Night
overview: On the night of a crippling transit strike in Berlin, two strangers are thrown together while their personal lives fall apart. After Maggie’s every possession is packed into Sam’s taxi, they discover a spark. But as the meter ticks – and the night gets weirder – it dawns that timing might be everything.

title: Roots
overview: A Black teenager falsifies a paternity test in hopes of convincing his white adoptive parents that he’s their biological son.

title: Marie-Rose and the Mysterious Journey
overview: Marie-Rose and the Mysterious Journey is an animated 3D feature film based on the iconic show of Chantal Goya.

title: The House That Zombies Built
overview: Zombies have overrun the earth, and young Scott's the last to learn about it - so he can't be too picky when it comes to choosing his safe haven.

title: Family Xmas
overview: Taras Hrynchenko, a lonely elderly war veteran, decides to cut all contacts with his family for reasons unbeknownst to anyone but himself. His eight-year-old son Mirchyk accidentally comes across a pile of unopened letters that the family has been trying to send to Taras for years, yet, as they were never able to trace him, the letters never reached their intended destination. However, after a surprising mishap, the family ultimately ends up together at the Christmas table. However, things aren't as idyllic as it seems, with the many unresolved conflicts and grievances threatening to undermine an idyllic reunion.

title: Der Hagel or yum and how I ate it all up last year
overview: Ratko makes his living selling drugs around New York City, getting from one place to another via his beloved bicycle. Misfortune continually befalls both Ratko and those around him, as though the man himself is cursed to struggle.

title: 3xHelô
overview: A girl just broke up with her boyfriend and needs to talk.

title: Make or Break
overview: After being offered a record label deal before one of their gigs, a band ponders how this could change their lives, for better or for worse.

title: The Wyverns
overview: Jura, summer 1912. Two sisters, Marie (11 years old) and Suzanne (15), flee their daily lives for  cross the forest and reach the cave of the Vouivre, legendary female figure and  incarnation of nature, supposed to devour those who dare to challenge it. Between belief and  emancipation, their expedition takes an unexpected turn. The Vouivre may not exist  Not but the myth becomes a weapon.

title: Adieu L'Amour
overview: Henri has become a real jerk. It’s been two years since his relationship with Émilie ended. Everyone has moved on. Not him. His job as a photographer no longer interests him, and human relationships even less. Bitter and increasingly alone. Until the day a man breaks into his home.

title: The Breath Of Freedom
overview: Because taming and caring for the wild horses is demanding, they are released back into the mountains before winter arrives, left to their fate in the hope of capturing them again the following year. Witnessed through the eyes of a young boy, this story explores, through images, the delicate balance between nature and humanity, and the tension between ownership and freedom.

title: Limerence
overview: Nora is an eccentric young woman with a debilitating infatuation with her newspaper delivery man — a man she has never even dared to speak to... Things begin to change when one fateful night, he appears to her in a dreamlike vision where he promises her everything she has ever longed for. Convinced this is her chance at true love, Nora decides to take a leap of faith in pursuit of her prince charming’s undivided affection.

title: The Caged
overview: A family is terrorised by a dark presence after they move into a quaint cottage, and discover it lies on the site of a medieval prison which once housed women accused of witchcraft.

title: The First Gokturk: Prologue
overview: This rebellion, which began with Bumin, Istemi, and his mentor Alagar, will write the epic of a people who broke their chains and re-emerged on the stage of history.

title: Bow and Apple
overview: After a scientist crash-lands in a remote jungle, he is found by a solitary runaway hunter who has built her life deep in the forest. Despite their differences, the two form an uneasy alliance when they discover they’re hunted by the same enemy—the brutal president who possesses the mythical Golden Apple, a relic said to hold immense, world-shaping power.

title: NO TE VAS A MATAR HOY
overview: Pedro tries to reconnect with his daughter after his wife's death. However, guilt transforms their home into an oppressive environment, plunging him into a spiral of madness where the boundaries of reality disappear.

title: Infinity Disclosed
overview: A look at how a russian scientist created a manual on how to construct a UFO.

title: The Devil's Due
overview: For inquisitor Jude Price, sobriety meant leaving his demons behind. But when a trail of strange disappearances leads back to his former local, he realises they've been awaiting his return.

title: Untitled Coming of Age Film
overview: Plot unknown.

title: Wings
overview: A student on a field trip imagines himself as a classic pilot to work up the courage to talk to his crush.

title: The Selling Stage
overview: At the end of a twenty-five-year career, LuFisto confronts the cost of chasing a dream that asked for everything and gave back less than promised.

title: Shredded Cheese
overview: A mockumentary follows a young man whose uncontrollable addiction to shredded cheese begins to disrupt his daily life and worry the people around him.

title: New Year’s Eve Concert with Berliner Philharmoniker
overview: Can classical music be humorous? Absolutely!  The Berliner Philharmoniker and their chief conductor Kirill Petrenko will demonstrate this at the 2026 New Year’s Eve Concert: in his sparkling Symphonie classique, Sergei Prokofiev parodies the music of Haydn and Mozart.  Dmitri Shostakovich also had the First Viennese School in mind when he wrote his witty Double Concerto for Piano and Trumpet.  In this performance, pianist Alexander Malofeev, born in 2001, makes his debut alongside principal trumpeter David Guerrier.  Kirill Petrenko also sets off a fireworks display of mischief with Richard Strauss’s Till Eulenspiegel’s Merry Pranks.
